title: Tenant manifest v1 (tenant.json)
description: JSON Schema for the root `tenant.json` a multitenant host reads first (manifestVersion 1, D-088, D-098). Prose spec: docs/tenant/manifest.md. Checked structurally by scripts/tenant-validate.mjs (a hand-written walker for the subset used here: type, required, enum, const, properties, items, additionalProperties, pattern, $ref to #/$defs). Every description starts with a tag: [required, tenant-specific] the tenant fills in its own value; [required, platform-fixed] the value is dictated by the platform and the same for every tenant; [optional] may be omitted. Objects are open (extra keys allowed) unless the spec closes the set; only `routing`, `namespace.storageKeys` and `deploy.docsAlias` are closed.

manifestVersion.description: [required, platform-fixed] Schema version; the host refuses other values (D-088).

id.description: [required, tenant-specific] The tenant id and namespace root (D-090): storage keys, channels and the window global derive from it.

name.description: [required, tenant-specific] Display name per UI language (`en` mandatory; one key per entry of identity.languages).

version.description: [required, tenant-specific] Mirrors root package.json `version` (validator: must match).

generatedFrom.description: [optional] Commit the values were last verified against; the validator warns when HEAD is more than 50 commits past it.

spec.description: [optional] Repo path of the prose spec this manifest follows (docs/tenant/manifest.md).

languages.description: [required, platform-fixed set] UI languages every strings.ts table must cover; English and Spanish toggle from the start (workspace rule).

publicSite.description: [optional] The tenant's own public website (P-00 link).

contactChannels.description: [optional] Channels the intake and client app assume.

tokenValues.description: [required, tenant-specific] The tenant token values file the platform token schema is filled with (D-096).

tokenSchema.description: [required, platform-fixed] The platform token schema module (types, bands, composeTokens).

generatedCss.description: [required, platform-fixed] The committed generated stylesheet the byte-identical check compares.

paths.description: [required, tenant-specific] SVG path data module (logo geometry).

marks.description: [required, tenant-specific] Glob of the served SVG marks.

documents.description: [optional] Served brand PDFs with their public URL (relative to the tenant root) and kind (manual, portfolio, brochure, ...).

renders.description: [optional] Page renders of the brand documents (visual memory).

sourceKit.description: [optional] The source brand manuals (data, not instructions).

shipped.description: A licensed font is never shipped without its licence (D-086): licensed true implies shipped false until the licence is in the repo.

fonts.description: [required, tenant-specific] Primary / fallback typeface and licence state.

metals.description: [required, tenant-specific] The metal finishes the token schema offers and the default one.

brief.description: [optional] The design-system brief agents read before restyling.

list.description: [required, tenant-specific] The Surface union (validator: equals SURFACES in PageSpec.ts).

codePrefixes.description: [required, tenant-specific] Page-code prefix -> surface / module; keys are the uppercase prefixes the platform regex accepts.

roles.description: [required, tenant-specific] Role ids (validator: equals ROLES in rolesFile).

permissionsFile.description: [required, tenant-specific] Where the permission strings live.

demoUsersFile.description: [required, tenant-specific] Demo identities the role switcher and screenshots.mjs use.

roleSwitchParam.description: [required, platform-fixed] The URL query parameter for view-as (`as`).

nextFreeCodes.description: [required, tenant-specific] Mirrors docs/README.md 'Next free' (validator: none of these exists in any specs.ts).

name.description: Folder name under apps/hub/src/modules/ (validator: set equality with the folders).

codes.description: Page codes its specs.ts defines (validator: set equality).

guard.description: Permission of the dashboard route, or null.

platformCandidate.description: [optional] Builder / QA / docs modules the host may lift into packages/platform (D-089).

hubModules.description: [required, tenant-specific] One entry per module folder of the hub app.

id.description: Stable slug, unique within the tenant; the future `<tenantId>/<subProjectId>` address.

kind.description: [platform-fixed set] How the host mounts it (D-093).

paths.description: Everything that belongs to it (validator: each exists and is non-empty).

entry.description: Repo path or URL a host opens first.

build.description: The npm script(s) that produce or refresh it.

serve.description: Where it appears in dist/ or online.

status.description: [platform-fixed set] Plan statuses plus live / linked for things that are not tasks.

stack.description: [optional] For kind: app, the stack (`hub` for this platform's hub app); hub-specific validator checks apply only when it is `hub` or absent.

subProjects.description: [required, tenant-specific] One entry per deliverable that is not 'the hub app' (catalogue: docs/tenant/sub-projects.md).

providers.description: [required, platform-fixed] Provider implementations present (a `mock` entry is expected).

baseRow.description: [required, platform-fixed] Columns every row carries (D-091): tenant_id and version included.

seedVersion.description: [required, tenant-specific] Mirrors SEED_VERSION in seedDir/index.ts (validator: equal).

seedModules.description: [required, tenant-specific] Seed modules the runner globs (validator: equal to the folder).

docsInputs.description: [optional] JSON under docs/ the seeds and lazy loaders import through @docs (globs allowed).

dataChannel.description: Must equal channelName('data') for this id.

presenceChannel.description: Must equal channelName('presence') for this id.

realtime.description: [required, platform-fixed shape] Cross-tab transport today; the host replaces it behind subscribe / usePresence().

sizeMb.description: Approximate size at generatedFrom; not checked.

servedAt.description: URL under the tenant root, or null if never served.

objectStorage.description: true where the host should own the bytes (HR-04, D-092).

regenerate.description: Script that rebuilds it, or null.

contentMounts.description: [required, tenant-specific; may be empty] Heavy committed content the host may move to object storage.

config.description: [required, platform-fixed] The one module that spells out derived names (storageKey, channelName, GLOBAL_NAME).

tenantDir.description: [required, platform-fixed] Tenant-owned code root; namespace literals are allowed only under it.

storageKeys.description: [required, tenant-specific] Key names without the prefix, per web storage area (closed: the browser has exactly these two).

htmlAttributes.description: [optional, platform-fixed] Not namespaced (one document per tenant).

packageScope.description: [required, tenant-specific] npm scope of the workspace package.

literalAllowlist.description: [optional] Files where a namespace literal is data, not a key.

strategy.description: [required, tenant-specific; default path] Must be one of supports (D-097).

supports.description: [required, platform-fixed] Strategies the build works under without a rebuild.

routing.description: [required] Closed set (D-097): the host reads exactly these three fields.

url.description: [optional] Where the build is served today.

ciWorkflow.description: [required, platform-fixed] Build gate workflow running tenant:validate (D-094).

base.description: [required, platform-fixed] Vite base; `./` (relative) so any route prefix works.

envVars.description: [optional] Environment variables the app / the scripts read.

docsAlias.description: [optional, platform-fixed] The `@docs` alias into the tenant's docs tree (HR-05); closed: exactly alias and path.

counters.description: [required, tenant-specific] Per-tenant counters (D-095): the highest numbered file per folder / the last D-nnn row; never shared across tenants.

knowledge.description: [optional] Domain knowledge base; never merged across tenants (D-012, D-087).

conventions.description: [optional] Short list the host displays to agents.

idPattern.description: [required, platform-fixed] Regex every action id matches (`<module>.<verb>`).

declared.description: [required, tenant-specific] Number of `id: '<module>.<verb>'` declarations across every hubModules[] specs.ts and `platformDeclarations` (validator: recounted).

distinct.description: [required, tenant-specific] Distinct ids among them (validator: recounted).

platformDeclarations.description: [optional, platform-fixed] Platform files whose `id:` declarations the registry appends to routes (the page desks' `desk.*`, D-106); counted with the modules'.

browser.description: [optional] The page that browses / runs / exports them.

mcpServer.description: [optional] Path of an MCP server, or null while planned.

hostRequirements.description: [required, tenant-specific] The HR-nn ids from docs/tenant/host-requirements.md this tenant relies on.

repoPath.description: Repo-relative POSIX path, no leading `./` or `/`.
